item.description: Indonesian rescuers launched a search operation on Sunday after authorities lost contact with a passenger ship carrying more than 240 people in the Java Sea while travelling from East Java to South Kalimantan province, officials said. The Search and Rescue Office in the city of Banjarmasin in South Kalimantan, which is located on Borneo Island, said it received a report two hours after contact was lost with the Virgo Transport 8 at about 2am on Sunday. item.description: En Guantánamo, lo provisional dura ya un cuarto de siglo. Quedó aquella imagen que estremeció al mundo: cuerpos de mono naranja, arrodillados, con los ojos y los oídos tapados. Barack Obama y Joe Biden ordenaron cerrarla.
